name: Yasukuni Akane
source:
Akane had average powers even though she came from a distinguished family, so she trained hard daily to improve her skills. Watching her, The main Protagonist can’t help but want to help her.
She is a Classmate of the Protagonist who uses a Sword alongside with Fire-Abilities and was the first Girl which appeared in the game.
